description: This file implements the HostResolverNat64Task class, which handles DNS resolution and IPv6 synthesis for NAT64 environments within the Chromium networking code.

classes.name: HostResolverNat64Task
classes.description: Handles DNS resolution and IPv6 address synthesis for NAT64 environments, including resolving ipv4only.arpa and converting IPv4 addresses to IPv6.

methods.name: HostResolverNat64Task::HostResolverNat64Task
methods.description: Constructor initializing the NAT64 resolution task with hostname, network key, logging, context, cache, and resolver.

methods.name: HostResolverNat64Task::Start
methods.description: Begins the resolution process, setting up the completion callback.

methods.name: HostResolverNat64Task::DoLoop
methods.description: Main loop handling different resolution states.

methods.name: HostResolverNat64Task::DoResolveComplete
methods.description: Handles completion of DNS request, fallback to original IPv4 if needed.

methods.name: HostResolverNat64Task::DoSynthesizeToIpv6
methods.description: Converts IPv4 addresses to IPv6 using DNS64 prefix.

methods.name: HostResolverNat64Task::OnIOComplete
methods.description: Callback for DNS request completion, continues processing.
